research_notes.logo: Verified on the awarding body's own domain. https://study.um.edu.my/images/img-logo-UM.png returned HTTP 200 with content-type image/png and 99174 bytes; file signature is PNG, 1193x375, 8-bit RGBA. Rendered and confirmed as a dark navy 'UNIVERSITI MALAYA' wordmark with the yellow/blue/red crest on a white background, so it passes the rule-6 exclusion of white-on-transparent wordmarks. The same header ships a white variant at images/img-logo-UM-putih.png (Malay 'putih' = white), which was deliberately not used. logo_host_taken is false for b133, so this is a new entry.
